title: DS3M: Deep structured state space models for nonlinear system identification on modern hardware
abstract: arXiv:2611.25274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural state-space identification learns dynamical models from measured inputs and outputs. SUBNET combines this task with an encoder that estimates initial states from short measurement histories. Its continuous-time version requires many successive neural-network evaluations during numerical integration, resulting in slow training speed which is a major limitation for practical use cases. We propose deep structured state space models (DS3M), which combine compact nonlinear dynamical components in parallel and in series. Custom GPU kernels implemented with Triton reduce the launch and memory overhead of their sequential evaluation. We explain this construction, describe a port-Hamiltonian variant, and present various benchmark comparisons of accuracy and training time.

translated_title: DS3M：在现代硬件上用于非线性系统辨识的深度结构化状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 神经状态空间辨识从测量到的输入和输出中学习动力学模型。SUBNET 将这一任务与一个编码器相结合，该编码器从较短的测量历史中估计初始状态。其连续时间版本在数值积分过程中需要多次连续的神经网络评估，导致训练速度缓慢，这是实际应用中的一个主要限制。我们提出了深度结构化状态空间模型（DS3M），它以并联和串联的方式组合紧凑的非线性动力学组件。使用 Triton 实现的自定义 GPU 内核降低了其顺序评估的启动和内存开销。我们解释了这一构建方法，描述了一种端口哈密顿变体，并给出了关于准确性和训练时间的多种基准比较。
tldr: 本文提出深度结构化状态空间模型DS3M，通过以并联和串联方式组合紧凑的非线性动力学组件，并利用Triton实现的自定义GPU内核降低顺序评估开销，显著提升了非线性系统辨识中神经状态空间模型的训练速度。
en_tdlr: We propose DS3M, deep structured state space models that combine compact nonlinear dynamical components in parallel and in series, with custom Triton-implemented GPU kernels that reduce launch and memory overhead, significantly accelerating training in neural state-space identification for nonlinear systems on modern hardware.
